climate-narrative-analyzer.name: climate-narrative-analyzer
climate-narrative-analyzer.description: A dashboard that collects climate news and uses AI to show how different outlets tell the story: who is presented as responsible, who is affected, and which wider themes recur.

news-comment-moderator.name: news-comment-moderator
news-comment-moderator.description: Uses pretrained transformer models to detect the frames used in a news article, then evaluates comments made in response and gives structured feedback — including healthiness, risk level, and suggested reformulations.
